headline: Musk says he is ‘not MAGA’ and regrets midterm spending
summary: At The New York Times' DealBook Summit, Elon Musk said he is “not MAGA” and distanced himself from the political movement linked to Donald Trump. He also said he wasn't sure what the term MAGA meant, and said he felt “pretty foolish” for the amount of money he spent during the U.S. midterms.
